cokkha.p: [Cusa+ta] (ti) CL=10 'ta' changes into 'kkha'; Drop the last of root 'sa'; (Co-Skt)] Pure and clean; A person.

H: cokkha：a．[Sk．cokṣa，caṅkṣa] 清潔乾淨的．-bhāva 清潔乾淨的性質或狀態.
S: cokkha：a．[Sk．cokṣa，caṅkṣa] 清き．-bhāva 清きこと.

cokkha：cokkha（ti）
စောက္ခ（တိ）
[cusa+ta．ta- kkha-pru，dhā sa-khye．（co-saṃ）]
[စုသ+တ။ တ-ကို က္ခ-ပြု၊ ဓာတွန် သ-ချေ။ （စော-သံ）]
P: Cokkha，（adj.） [Cp．Sk．cokṣa] clean J.III，21； °bhāva cleanliness M.I，39 （=visuddhibhāva； to be read for T mokkha°? See Trenckner’s note on p．530）．（Page 272）

cokkha：စောက္ခ （တိ）
စင်ကြယ်သည်။
DOP: cokkha mfn. [ S. cokṣa, caukṣa; AMg cukkha, cokkha], pure; clean ; Ja III 21, 26´ (vaggū ti ~ā nimmalā, Be so; Ce, Se pokkhā; Ee vokkhā); — °- cokkha , mfn. , very pure ; Ps I 150, 3 (jaññajaññaṃ viyā ti ~aṃ viya manāpa-manāpaṃ viya, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se mokkhamokkhaṃ; Ps-ṭ [ Be ] I 252, 14 : taṃ paramaparisuddhaṃ manoharaṃ ca hotī ti āha ~an ti); — °- jātika , mfn. , clean; disposed to purity ; Th-a II 135, 20 (yaṃ … mataṃ kalebaraṃ taṃ … eke ~ā jigucchanti oloketuṃ pi na icchanti, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee mokkhajātikā; — acokkhajātika, mfn. , unclean, impure ; Ud-a 52, 27 (mānavasena ca kodha-vasena ca sabbaṃ acokkhajātikaṃ passitvā jigucchanto huhun ti karonto vicarati, so read ?; Be, Se avokkha-jātikaṃ; Ce, Ee atakkajātikaṃ); — °- brāhmaṇa , m. , a clean brahman; a brahman concerned with purity ; Vibh-a 424, 17 (sucikāmo ~o gūthaṃ viya kiñci saṅkhāraṃ sukhato upagacchati, Be so; Ce, Se pokkharabrāhmaṇo; Ee bhokkhi brāhmaṇo) ≠ Ps IV 107, 21 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pokkharabrāhmaṇo); — °- bhāva , m. , purity; Ps I 177, 27 (lokkhasammatā ti lūkhabhāvasammatā, lūkhabhāvan ti ~aṃ, visuddha-bhāvaṃ detī ti evaṃ sammatā ti, Be so; Ce, Ee lokhya-sammatā ti; Se mokkhabhāvaṃ, visuddhibhāvaṃ detī ti).
